item.title: Yuutousei Kurashina Mutsumi ~Hamedori Nakadashi Douga~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Airy Socks
  • 発売日: 2016-11-22
  • スコア: 6.0600000000000005/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 優等生倉科むつみ ～ハメ撮り膣射し動画～
  • 英語名: Yuutousei Kurashina Mutsumi Hamedori Nakadashi Douga

あらすじ

Honor student Kurashina Mutsumi studies hard day and night.

Neat and with an aura of gentleness, she is secretly adored by many male students, but she leads a peaceful school life oblivious to such things.

However, in order to save a friend of hers who is in financial trouble, she contacts a man through the internet and enters a deal with him, completely ignorant of the details.
